title: ItemTranslate
description: The mod for translate the text on your item
body:
# 繁體中文介紹
**itemTranslate 是一個專為《Wynncraft》等大型 RPG 伺服器設計的 Fabric 純客戶端 裝備翻譯模組。滑鼠移到物品上，就能瞬間將複雜的英文屬性替換為你熟悉的語言！**

### ✨ 核心功能 (Features)
🔍 智慧單字擷取 (G 鍵)：自動過濾裝備上的顏色代碼與標點符號，精準抓取未知的英文單字，並透過 Google 翻譯即時轉換入庫！

🎨 完美支援顏色與格式：支援 Minecraft 原生 & 顏色代碼（例如將 Legendary 翻譯設定為 &6&l傳奇&r，即可顯示金色粗體字）。

⚙️ 強大的 GUI 設定介面 (P 鍵)：內建完整的「翻譯規則總表」與「Google 暫存區」，可自由調整翻譯優先級，並支援 JSON 檔案的導入與匯出。

🛡️ 100% 純客戶端模組：伺服器端完全不需要安裝。在 Wynncraft、Hypixel 或任何生存伺服器使用皆安全且合法！

### ⌨️ 快捷鍵說明 (Keybindings)
(為防止誤觸，G 鍵與 O 鍵僅在開啟背包或容器介面時生效)

P 鍵：開啟模組設定介面

G 鍵：擷取當前游標所指裝備的英文單字，並進行 Google 翻譯

O 鍵：一鍵開啟 / 關閉翻譯功能

### ⚠️ 必備前置模組 (Dependencies)
安裝本模組前，請務必確認您的 mods 資料夾內已安裝以下兩款前置模組，否則遊戲將無法啟動：

Fabric API

YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL) (請使用 v3 以上版本)

# English Description
**itemTranslate is a client-side Fabric mod designed specifically for RPG servers like Wynncraft. It allows you to instantly translate item tooltips and stats into your preferred language on the fly!**

### ✨ Key Features
🔍 Smart Word Extraction (Press G): Hover over any item and press G. The mod automatically filters out color codes/symbols, captures unknown English words, and translates them instantly via Google Translate!

🎨 Custom Color Codes: Fully supports Minecraft's & formatting codes. (e.g., set translation to &6&lLegendary&r for Gold + Bold text).

⚙️ Powerful Config GUI (Press P): Easily manage your translation priority rules and Google cache. Supports importing/exporting JSON rule files.

🛡️ Client-Side Only: Does not need to be installed on the server. 100% safe and allowed to use on multiplayer servers like Wynncraft or Hypixel!

### ⌨️ Keybindings
(To prevent accidental clicks, 'G' and 'O' are only active when an inventory/GUI is open)

P : Open Config Menu

G : Extract and translate untranslated words from the hovered item

O : Toggle translation ON/OFF

### ⚠️ Required Dependencies
This mod requires the following mods to run. The game will crash upon startup if they are missing:

Fabric API

YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL) (v3 or higher)
